normalization.title_normalization: Unicode NFKC plus whitespace collapse only
normalization.subtitle_role: supporting context/race stage; never sole episode boundary

derivation_order.rule: use an explicit official meeting schedule/meeting identifier when available
anchor episode at venue+normalized title+初日 and follow explicit N日目 labels in chronological schedule order
infer 最終日 only when the same scheduled episode has prior day anchors and no contradictory title/status
for 順延/中止/missing day_label, use official schedule exception metadata; otherwise leave day number null

episode_id_rule.null_rule: if episode start cannot be established without guessing, episode_id is null

day_number_rules.最終日: derive from confirmed episode schedule or prior monotonic anchors
day_number_rules.中止: do not create a completed meeting day automatically
day_number_rules.missing: null unless official schedule resolves it

episode_boundaries: new 初日 at same venue after previous episode
confirmed end of previous schedule followed by a new title/schedule
non_boundaries: calendar gap alone without schedule evidence
title punctuation/width difference after conservative normalization
